title: Annual leave (paid time off) policy
body: Full-time employees accrue 20 days of annual leave per year and part-time employees accrue leave pro rata. Up to 5 unused days carry over into the next calendar year. Leave requests are submitted in the HR portal at least two weeks in advance.

steps.text: Check the employee's current annual leave balance in days
Tell the employee that up to 5 unused days carry over and requests need two weeks notice

resolution_summary: Full-time employees accrue 20 days per year; up to 5 days carry over.

title: Parental leave policy
body: Employees with at least 12 months of service receive 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave, which can be taken within 12 months of a birth or adoption. Employees should notify HR at least 8 weeks before the planned start.

steps.text: Explain that employees with 12 months of service receive 16 weeks of paid parental leave
Tell the employee to notify HR at least 8 weeks before the leave starts

resolution_summary: Eligible employees receive 16 weeks of paid parental leave.

title: Benefits eligibility: medical, dental, vision and 401k
body: Medical and 401k benefits are available to full-time and part-time employees. Dental and vision are available to full-time employees after 30 days of service. Contractors are not eligible for company benefits.

steps.text: Check the employee's benefits eligibility for the requested plan
Tell the employee how to enrol through the benefits portal during the enrolment window

resolution_summary: Eligibility depends on employment type and length of service.

title: New hire onboarding
body: Hiring managers start onboarding at least five business days before a new hire's start date. Onboarding creates the equipment order, accounts and the first-week schedule.

steps.text: Start the onboarding checklist for the new hire with their start date
Tell the manager that equipment and accounts are prepared before the start date

resolution_summary: The onboarding checklist covers equipment, accounts and the first-week schedule.

title: Payroll discrepancies
body: Payroll discrepancies are handled by the payroll team through an HR ticket. Corrections are paid in the next payroll cycle.

steps.text: Open an HR ticket in the payroll category describing the discrepancy
Tell the employee that payroll corrections are paid in the next payroll cycle

resolution_summary: Payroll responds to discrepancy tickets within three business days.

title: Workplace concerns and harassment reports
body: Reports of harassment, discrimination or bullying are handled confidentially by an HR Business Partner. They must never be logged as a standard HR ticket.

steps.text: Escalate confidentially to an HR Business Partner
Tell the employee that the report is confidential and that retaliation is prohibited

resolution_summary: An HR Business Partner contacts the employee within one business day.

title: Updating personal details
body: Changes to address, legal name, bank details or emergency contacts are processed by HR operations through an HR ticket.

steps.text: Open an HR ticket in the personal details category for the change
Tell the employee that HR operations processes the change within two business days

resolution_summary: Personal detail changes are processed within two business days.

title: Employee data privacy
body: HR support never shares another employee's compensation, leave, health or personal information. Employees can only access their own records.

steps.text: Explain that HR support cannot share another employee's personal or compensation information

resolution_summary: Employees can view only their own HR records.
